lines.en: : Hey, Kirin. Are you home right now?
I knock on Kirin’s door, hoping to be able to spend some time alone with her tonight.
But, without knowing what Noriko is up to, it’s highly probable that that won’t be happening at all.
That’s not to say I don’t like Noriko either, it’s just-
Kirin seems to function a little differently around me than she does with others.
Or, who knows? Maybe that’s just something I tell myself to feel special.
: Yup! Feel free to let yourself in, Sensei. Door is always open to you.
I quickly open the door and let myself into the room.
The same fruity aroma that greeted me the last time I was here welcomes me with open arms once again.
And before long, I am facing two cute girls and an upside down house.
: Excellent timing as always, Sensei.
: Noriko and I were just about to watch a movie.
: Hey! Have you seen this one before, Sensei?
: They play it on repeat in the old district all the time, but Kirin’s telling me she’s never seen it before.
: I can't be sure if I’ve seen it if I don’t even know what it’s called.
: The weird house certainly doesn’t look familiar to me.
: Huh...Now that I think about it, I don’t really know what the title is either. But it’s a super weird movie.
: You’ll probably like it.
: I get why Noriko wants to watch this, but I didn’t take you as the type to be into...abstract movies, Kirin.
: I don’t really care. I just want to hang out under the kotatsu and unwind.
: It’s been a pretty long day, to be honest.
: How come it's normal for me to do weird stuff but not normal for Kirin?
: I'm not actually weird, am I?
: Want to maybe join us or something, Sensei?
: Not sure if you’re aware, but Noriko is kind of crazy about you, so there’s no chance she’d say no.
: All I ask is that there’s no funny business under the table, including any conducted with me.
: I just spent my entire last paycheck on this kotatsu and I don’t want it to get all gross after just a couple uses.
: Think you can hold back for an hour or two? Or would you rather go bang on Ayane’s door for some “instant” satisfaction?
: Stop saying questionable things in front of the girl with the pocket knife.
: Hm? Did Kirin say something questionable?
: My hearing’s not great, so I probably didn’t catch it.
: Good.
: But yeah. I wouldn’t mind staying and hanging out here if that’s okay with you two.
: Great! I call shotgun.
: Hey! I was about to call shotgun!
: Am I a vehicle now?
: Yup. Noriko and I are gonna ride you all the way to Mt. Fuji.
: Just not under the kotatsu.
: Shotgun in this context means you have to sit next to me.
: Which you should probably be thanking me for, since God only knows what would happen over on the crazy side.
: Nothing would happen! I don’t even normally bite!
: Normally?...
: There’s a time and a place for everything, Sensei~
: You know, I could always just sit in the middle and not offend-
: Nope. I called shotgun.
: If you break shotgun rules, you have to spend the rest of your life cleaning our room.
: You intend to live here forever?
Well, actually...it's not like there's really a choice.
: Okay, whatever. You have to clean the room until we move out.
: Fine. Please forgive me for trying to make everyone happy.
: Making everyone happy never works, Sensei. You’ve gotta pick one person and just focus everything you can on them.
: I have learned the hard way that you are very much incorrect.
Kirin twirls around and heads over to the side of the kotatsu opposite Noriko, gracefully sliding herself under the blanket while keeping it lifted up so I can get under as well.
I oblige, realizing halfway through entering that I forgot to take my shoes off.
I’m glad that Noriko’s love for me apparently surpasses her desire to keep the kotatsu clean, because this is something that I should very much be called out on right now.
: Comfortable?
: Kind of cramped. But I’m pretty large and this isn’t the biggest kotatsu in the world.
: Mmmm!
: ...What?
: I don’t like how close you two are.
: Oh, come on. All we’re doing is sitting...
: I agreed to not catch feelings or whatever, but I never said I’d stay six feet away from him for the rest of eternity.
: I know, but I’m still jealous!
: And also a little excited because my feet are touching Sensei’s knees right now.
: Those are my knees.
: Oh my God, why are your knees so big?
: Wha- They’re not! They’re normal-sized knees!
: Nuh-uh. I’ve got tiny knees. They’re like little golf balls that hold my legs together.
: Have fun breaking your legs, then! That’s way too small!
: Kirin, you really KNEEd to chill out right now. Other people might be sleeping.
: Get it?!
: Because, like-
: Knees...
: Hah...
: Oh, come on! That was good!
: And what's with these weird matching expressions?!
: Are you sure you're not in love?!
: Can we just watch your stupid upside down house movie now?
: You mean the movie that’s been playing the entire time we’ve been talking?
: I kinda just assumed you didn’t care since you weren’t paying any attention to it.
: Oh. Would you look at that?
: It actually is on.
: I guess it wouldn't hurt to watch a little bit of it. Especially since you’ve seen it so many times.
The three of us direct our attention to the giant glowing rectangle in front of us.
Somehow or another, and please forgive me for not understanding the science, it channels electricity into moving images.
Moving images that...look awfully real for something that is apparently just a movie.
There are five girls in a house together, gathered around a small kitchen table.
The windows around them are boarded and they’re eating a strange gray substance piled high on their plates.
No one is saying or doing anything.
: Noriko, what the fuck are we watching?
: It’s an arthouse film! I think. I don’t know.
: It’s weird. I’ve actually never finished it.
: Something always comes up in the middle and I have to leave.
: It’s like, a really long movie.
: Are you sure you’re not just falling asleep?
: Of course I’m not falling asleep!
: Probably.
: I don’t know! Maybe! Just watch! Stuff is gonna happen soon.
We continue to focus on the television.
It seems as if one of the girls has finished eating before the rest of them.
Or...actually, wait. Maybe she hasn't?
She stands up and grabs her plate, announcing to the others that she’s tired and is going to head to bed.
A small girl with pink hair, almost the same color as Noriko's, chases after her, clearly upset with the decision.
But the one who stood up closes the door in her face, placing her plate of unidentifiable gray food (?) on the floor beside her mattress.
: What’s that thing in the corner of the room?
: What thing? What are you talking about?
: That big-ass metal tube thing. Do you not see it?
: Ooooh, that. Uhh...a water heater, maybe?
: It’s hard to tell since it’s cut off by the wall.
: Huh...
: So...when does the stuff start happening?
A hand finds its way into my lap and I already have a good idea of where this is going.
I’m sorry, Noriko. At this rate, your kotatsu is going to be destroyed.
: Huh...that’s so weird. This is actually a little different than I remember.
: I mean...it’s been a while since I’ve seen it, though, so I could be misremembering.
: Actually, is this even the same thing I’ve watched before?
: The set looks the same and the girls look the same but I could have sworn that last time, they had like...actual food instead of that gray stuff.
: But I guess it could just be the coloring of the TV that's making it look that way?
: What do you think, Kirin?
: I think this movie sucks.
: We’ve got Netflix. Why don’t we just watch something on that instead of this weird, arthouse crap?
Kirin’s hand trails up my thigh to the zipper of my jeans, very slowly pulling it down so it doesn’t make any noise.
The way that she’s able to hold a conversation while doing this is actually quite impressive.
Extremely bold and I guess slightly surprising, but definitely impressive.
: Hmm...yeah, I guess if nobody else is enjoying it, we can do that.
: That’s so weird, though. It’s usually a lot more intense than this.
: Like, this one time, I watched one of the girls straight up hang herself and the others didn’t find out for like, three or four days.
: Maybe this is just the prequel or something?
: Sensei, is there anything you want to watch?
: Ooh! I’m interested in hearing your tastes, too.
: I don’t think we’ve talked much about movies yet.
: Uhh...hello? Sensei?
: Oh, uhh, sorry. I’m fine with anything.
: Hmm...you feeling okay?
: If you’re a little under the weather, maybe Noriko could run and grab you a bottle of water or something?
: Of course!
: But it looks to me like he could just be suffering from an anxiety attack.
: Before I leave, how about you try closing your eyes and counting to ten? We’ll do some breathing exercises together.
: No...Noriko. I really think it’s dehydration. It would be very nice if you were able to get him some water.
: Preferably from the vending machine on the ground floor.
: What? Why? There’s one right outside of our door and they just restocked it this morning.
: I remember specifically because I’ve been craving Coca-Cola ever since my sister’s commercial and I had to wait for them to finish before buying one.
I reach toward Kirin’s lap to return the favor, thinking that I’d be able to remain just as stealthy as she is.
However, it is extremely hard to mutually [masturbate] underneath a table while maintaining eye contact with someone uninvolved.
And even though this should probably be instilling some sort of nervousness in me, I’m really just more impressed at how easily Kirin was able to pull it off.
: Hey...you two just moved closer together, didn’t you?
: Nope. Now, about Netflix.
: And now your face is getting red...
: Then maybe I...need some water as well...Noriko...
: So thirsty.
: Could this be the end for me?
: Uhh...
: I knew it!
: That’s...my penis?
: I don’t think she’ll buy that the same way she bought the knee thing.
: I knew those knees were too big to actually be yours!
: They were mine! And they're totally normal knees!
: And after I specifically told you two no funny business under the kotatsu!
: What do you have to say for yourself, Kirin?
: Are you...you know...
: Going to move your foot?
: Of course not! We had a rule to not do stuff like this in front of each other!
: That’s why I was asking you to go get water specifically from the first floor...
: I’m obviously not going to just leave and let you hook up with the man I’m in love with!
: Have some dignity and do it behind my back! Not in my brand new kotatsu!
: Oh, and another thing! I-
: Wait, there’s more of it?
: Noriko! You’re making it even harder!
: Holy shit, it’s bigger than my foot.
: Hehehe...
: Does that feel good?
: Oh my God. Noriko, just leave.
: Senseiiiii~
: Okay, you need to stop or your kotatsu really will be destroyed.
: Hah...and to think that this is all because Noriko chose to watch some shitty movie when we could have just put on Stranger Things.
: Okaaaaay. Bye bye, boner~
: Until we meet again~
: Or until my roommate stops cockblocking me...
Noriko and Kirin both remove their respective appendages from me and I am suddenly stricken by a level of grief that is incomparable to anything else I have ever felt before.
: I feel like there was a much easier solution to this than just stopping in the middle.
: There are two beds in here. Why didn’t we use one of those?
: Dude, that’s not the same at all.
: It’s really not.
: Like, the thrill of getting caught is what makes it hotter. So I applaud Kirin for trying.
: Are we really not continuing?
: Mm...I’m kind of tired now. I think I'm just going to go to sleep.
: Yeah, I think I’m going to go take a shower.
: Why is this happening?
: Night, Sensei!
: Oh, and we totally wouldn’t have gotten caught if you didn’t try to finger me. So this was your fault.
: Ahhh! Shotgun is banned in our room from now on! That should have been me!
I hate Dorm 10.
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
